summary.text: Eric Phillips is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 48, which covers parts of Henry and Pittsylvania counties and the City of Martinsville.
Eric Phillips has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Eric Phillips was born in Martinsville, Virginia.
Eric Phillips studied at Virginia Western Community College (General Studies), Patrick Henry Community College (General Studies), and Lee University (History and Political Science).
Eric Phillips's listed occupation is president and CEO of the Phillips Group.

Eric Phillips's listed memberships and affiliations include the Boys and Girls Club of the Blue Ridge (chair), the Henry County Martinsville Republican Committee (chair), the Martinsville Economic Development Authority (chair), the Republican Party of Virginia Executive Committee (Western vice chair), the Martinsville Uptown Partnership (executive board member), the Martinsville Henry County Chamber of Commerce (past vice chair), and the Blue Ridge Innovation Corridor (past board member).
The profile lists Rebecca Ann Phillips as Eric Phillips's spouse.
The House profile lists Eric Phillips's committee assignments as Public Safety, Transportation, and Privileges and Elections.
